title: Kiñit Classification in Ethiopian Chants, Azmaris and Modern Music: A New Dataset and CNN Benchmark
findings: The study created a new dataset, EMIR, for Ethiopian music classification which includes Orthodox Tewahedo chants. The key finding was that the proposed CNN model (EKM) using Mel-frequency Cepstral Coefficient (MFCC) features on 3-second audio clips achieved the highest accuracy (95.00%) in classifying the musical scales (Kiñits), outperforming other models like AlexNet, ResNet50, VGG16, and LSTM.

measurement_description: The benchmark measures the accuracy of classifying Ethiopian musical scales (Kiñits) from audio clips. A portion of the dataset used for this benchmark consists of religious music, specifically Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo chants.
